title: KARMA's 'The Mistletoe' Brings Festive Flair and Soulful Cheer to the Holiday Season
htmlContent: KARMA is here to turn your festive song rotation on its head with a new single, “The Mistletoe.” This Memphis-based trio serves a festive anthem whose twinkle carries the season's charm but packs a strident, contemporary punch. If you’ve desired a holiday jam a la Destiny’s Child but with a touch of TLC swagger, this song absolutely fulfills your wish. https://open.spotify.com/track/2HAGOHxIZkuuBhXnK7xtUe?go=1&sp_cid=3496a3176bf36a68e741a4f0713e258b&utm_source=embed_player_p&utm_medium=desktop “The Mistletoe” bursts with playful, feel-good lyrics that conjure the magic of holiday romance and connection. From its infectious beat to gangbuster harmonies courtesy of KARMA, every performance element encourages chorus singing, foot movement, and seasonal rejoicing. The trio’s chemistry, sass, soul, and festive energy mesh harmoniously, making the track feel equally familiar and new. The song’s production is smooth but alive, crafting soulful vocals atop a retro and futuristic groove. It’s the kind of track that sounds equally at home in a cozy fireplace living room as it does on the dance floor of a holiday party. Whether you’re enjoying a special moment under the mistletoe or need an excuse to party, KARMA comes through with a holiday jam that delivers cheer from Memphis to the globe. “The Mistletoe” is a song, but it is also a soundtrack of a season of love, laughter, and connection.
